workflow

One explicit decision between request and shell.

01

request

Your client submits the exact command, working directory and timeout.

02

approve

Approve once, deny it, or save a revocable rule for that exact command and client.

03

execute

Perch runs only the approved request and returns output and completion status.

setup

Bring your own server.

Install Perch on your Linux VPS, expose it through HTTPS, then connect a compatible MCP client to <your-perch-url>/mcp.

For ChatGPT, connect your Perch instance with OAuth. Connecting authorises command requests; it does not bypass command approval.

install authentication ↗

early alpha — keep an independent recovery path such as SSH. An approved privileged command can still change or damage the server.
